_meta.reservation: b=max(.2, mixture quantile at qlevel); no own-deadline cap (ablation: capping lowers on-time in 6/6 stress cells)
_meta.info_levels: point_est / point_deb / model_quant / model_quant_deb / family_dist / family_pc / unit_resid / oracle_d(diagnostic only)
_meta.note: oracle_d violates information_rule; diagnostic upper bound, not used in any model selection
_meta.info_experiment: alpha held at the nominal mapping, so only d-information varies
_meta.online_alpha: bayes posterior over the five published mappings, updated on completed (d,p); exact solve is the fallback
_meta.debias: train mean pred-duration by prefix {'0.2': -1.562, '0.6': -1.5808, '1.0': -1.5573} (negative = point estimate short)
